# Svelte by LuKaria

## About
Svelte by LuKaria is a medical weight loss clinic based in Jamaica, offering doctor-guided, physician-supervised weight loss programs. We provide personalized care to help patients achieve their health and wellness goals.

## Services
- Medically supervised weight loss
- Physician consultations
- Personalized treatment plans
- Ongoing support and monitoring
